_comment: Config for render_ledger.py when rendering a skill-publisher SHIP ledger. Pass with --config @/absolute/path/to/ledger-render-config.json (the @ prefix tells render_ledger.py to load JSON from the file at that path; a bare path without @ is parsed as inline JSON and fails). The publisher's ledger uses 'Run' (not tracer's 'Round') and the POLISH/AUDIT/TIER/PACKAGE/PR phases. render_ledger.py was historically shared with skill-tracer's copy but, as of the 2026-06-20 shared-script sync contract retirement (HISTORY.md 1.2.0), is skill-publisher's own independent copy, free to diverge, with no live sync mechanism; this config is the only per-skill difference. The valid_actions set MUST stay in lockstep with recovery-protocol.md's action keywords; the renderer's INVALID ACTION flag is a lint only -- recovery-protocol.md's unknown-keyword->addressing rule governs actual execution.
